messages:
alex: Hey — I accepted the org invite but when I try to push to infra/gatekeeper I get "remote: Permission to redwood-inference/infra.git denied". GitHub also shows 2FA required even though I set up an Authenticator app. Who should I ping for access?

lina: @alex do you show up in the infra team? Check https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/teams and confirm you're listed under 'infra'. If not, someone from platform needs to add you. A screenshot of the error helps.

alex: I can see the org membership but not the infra team. My GitHub username is alex-chen.

it-support-bot: Heads-up: SAML SSO can require you to reauthorize after accepting an invite. Quick steps: 1) Visit https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/sso 2) Click "Authorize" for Redwood Inference 3) Re-verify 2FA in your Authenticator app. If that doesn't clear it, please open an internal ticket to IT-ACCESS with subject: "github sso relink" and include your gh username.

smita: @jordan can you add alex-chen to the infra team and grant write on infra/gatekeeper? tagging platform so this doesn't block first-week work.

jordan: done — I added alex-chen to the infra team and granted repo write. If you still see the permission error run: `gh auth login` then `git fetch` and try pushing again. If you used HTTPS creds, you might need to update the token (gh usually handles it).

alex: ran `gh auth login` and retried the push — it worked :tada: Thanks y'all, saved my afternoon.
